chapters.1.lds: The 2026 lesson applies the final verse to temple service for deceased people. This later Church reading differs from the vision’s judgment over Edom. Why does intercepting people who escape make Edom part of the violence?
chapters.1.summary: Obadiah’s vision concerns Edom, the nation descended from Esau. Edom lives high in the rocks and thinks no one can bring it down. God will bring it down. Its allies will deceive it, and its wise men will perish. Edom did violence to its brother Jacob. It stood aside while strangers looted Jerusalem. It gloated, entered the gates, and seized goods. It cut down those who fled, and what it did will be done to it.
